clue.text: Book that is left to a little boy

parts.note: Dan is a short name for a boy
i.e. (id est) is the abbreviation for 'that is'

explanation.surface: A bequest: a volume is left in a will to a small child.
explanation.definitionFit: Daniel is a book of the Old Testament, named after its prophet.

clue.text: Clerics left out of deal with cheats …

indicators.note: the word deal has the following piece taken out of it

parts.note: cons are swindles or tricks, so cheats

explanation.surface: Churchmen are dropped from a business deal arranged with fraudsters.
explanation.definitionFit: Deacons are ordained ministers of the church, a kind of cleric.

clue.text: … left out of a final redistribution in canteen

indicators.note: the letters of a final, less the removed letter, are dealt out afresh

parts.note: L is the standard abbreviation for left, and here it is the letter taken out

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue, something is left out when a final is reshuffled in a canteen.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis carries 'left out of' over from 1 Down: take L from A FINAL to leave AFINA, then rearrange those letters as 'redistribution' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: The NAAFI runs canteens and shops for British forces, so its name stands for a services canteen.

clue.text: Done with magic, converted and marrying within the tribe

indicators.note: converted means changed into another form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A conjuring act finished, and someone changed by the experience weds a fellow tribesman.
explanation.definitionFit: Endogamy is the custom of marrying only within one's own group, and this is its adjective.

clue.text: Games where one player hasn't scored almost over, crowd having left earlier

definitions.text: Games where one player hasn't scored

indicators.note: earlier tells us the abbreviation for left comes first, ahead of the other pieces
almost means the word over is cut short of its final letter

parts.note: a set is a group or crowd of people

explanation.surface: A tennis match is nearly finished, and the spectators have already gone home.
explanation.walkthrough: In tennis 'love' means zero, so a love set is one in which the loser wins no games.
explanation.definitionFit: A tennis set won six games to love is one where one player failed to take a single game.

clue.text: Left in after this time, so upset clovers

indicators.note: after places the word in behind the abbreviation for the era

parts.note: AD, anno domini, marks the present era, this time
taken as written

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the word so upside down

explanation.surface: Someone abandoned after a while is so distressed they wreck the clover patch.
explanation.definitionFit: Ladino is a large white clover grown for forage, so ladinos are clovers of that kind.

clue.text: Women on the make, like some fuses?

definitions.meaning: seductive women out to exploit men are called ...
read as ..., five amps in Roman numerals, the rating of a common plug fuse

explanation.surface: Flirtatious women are compared to electrical fuses.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the punning second definition: a 5-amp fuse, with V as the Roman five.
explanation.definitionFit: A vamp is a woman who uses her allure to manipulate men, one 'on the make'.

clue.text: A dark patch for our biggest star, left as troops move

definitions.text: A dark patch for our biggest star

indicators.note: the troops move about, so these letters are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Soldiers move off and leave a dark stain on a great celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Our biggest star' sounds like a celebrity, but it is the Sun, whose surface carries dark patches.
explanation.definitionFit: A sunspot, also called a solar spot, is a dark, cooler patch on the Sun's surface.

clue.text: Starts to turn right and immediately left side follows

indicators.note: the starts of each of the following words are taken, their first letters

explanation.surface: Driving directions: turn right, then straight away go left.
explanation.definitionFit: To trail someone is to follow behind them, as a tracker does.

clue.text: Agreement secured for Tunis only

indicators.note: the letters are held securely within the words Tunis only

explanation.surface: A deal has been signed covering only the city of Tunis.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in unison means acting together in full agreement.

clue.text: Left behind — a group badly done by

parts.note: a band is a group, as of musicians

indicators.note: badly signals that the letters of done are put together wrongly

explanation.surface: A pop group feels deserted after being poorly treated.
explanation.definitionFit: Something abandoned has been deserted, simply left behind.

clue.text: Opera singer left with a bachelor after me

indicators.note: after places the abbreviation for left and the degree behind me

parts.note: taken as written
a BA is a Bachelor of Arts, a bachelor's degree

explanation.surface: A diva complains that she has been left with an unmarried man after her.
explanation.definitionFit: Dame Nellie Melba was a celebrated Australian soprano, after whom peach Melba is named.

clue.text: Left unpaid, mowing man's heading off

indicators.note: off means that letter is taken away from the word mowing
a word's heading is its first letter, here that of man's

explanation.surface: A gardener has not been paid for cutting the grass and has gone off.
explanation.definitionFit: Money owing is still due, not yet paid.

clue.text: Is last-in turning about right, or turning to the left?

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go round the abbreviation for right
turning means the letters of is and last-in are turned into a new order

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about which way the last person in should turn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' appears twice: the first is the anagram signal, the second belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinistral means left-handed or spiralling to the left, from Latin sinister, left.

clue.text: A wise man thus left nothing to Scotsman

parts.note: so means thus, in this way
O, the zero shape, stands for nothing
Mon is a crossword name for a Scotsman, from Scots 'mon' for man

explanation.surface: A sage's will thus leaves nothing to a Scot.
explanation.definitionFit: King Solomon of the Bible is proverbial for his wisdom.

clue.text: That can be taken in, or left with the listener to catch the French

parts.note: an ear is the organ that listens
to nab is to catch or seize
le is French for 'the'

explanation.surface: Something easy to grasp, or a person left listening for the French to be caught.
explanation.definitionFit: What is learnable can be absorbed by study, taken in by the mind.

clue.text: Left inside, weeps and dozes

indicators.note: inside places the abbreviation for left within the synonym for weeps

parts.note: a wound or wall that weeps seeps, oozing liquid

explanation.surface: Someone abandoned indoors cries and then nods off.
explanation.definitionFit: To doze is to sleep lightly, so dozes means sleeps.

clue.text: Where to dine out on food served up hot

indicators.note: out means the letters of dine are put out of order
in a down clue, served up turns the word for food upwards

parts.note: grub is slang for food
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on a tap

explanation.surface: A guide to eating out, with dishes brought to the table piping hot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Where' is the definition, answered by a place: the clue as a whole asks where to eat out.
explanation.definitionFit: Edinburgh, Scotland's capital, is a place, the kind of answer the question 'where' wants.

clue.text: Left in France? That's rather awkward

definitions.meaning: a socially clumsy or tactless person is described with the borrowed French word

explanation.surface: Someone abandoned in France finds the situation embarrassing.
explanation.definitionFit: In English the French word for left has come to mean socially awkward or clumsy.

clue.text: Sensed trouble when left inside, never running out

indicators.note: inside places the abbreviation for left within the rearranged letters
the letters of sensed are troubled, stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone sensed danger when stranded indoors, and the supplies seemed inexhaustible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' turns SENSED into ENDESS, and 'inside' puts L within it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something endless has no end, so it never runs out.

clue.text: In dictionary, baseball glove is left out

indicators.note: in places the glove inside the abbreviation for the dictionary

parts.note: the OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
a mitt is the padded glove worn in baseball

explanation.surface: A baseball glove has been dropped from the dictionary.
explanation.definitionFit: Omitted means not included, simply left out.

clue.text: Road detour in order?

indicators.note: a detour takes an indirect route, so the letters of road are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A road diversion has been ordered, or is it in proper order?
explanation.definitionFit: To ordain is to decree or command, to order something formally.

clue.text: A penny given to the country — custom arising in duchy

parts.note: D was the symbol for an old British penny, from Latin denarius
UK, the United Kingdom, is the country in question

indicators.note: in a down clue, arising means the word for custom is read upwards

parts.note: mode means custom or fashion

explanation.surface: A small sum given to the nation is an old custom of a duke's estate.
explanation.definitionFit: A dukedom is the territory or title of a duke, which is a duchy.

clue.text: 2 i/c left half with a drippy hanger-on

indicators.note: the figure 2 says the abbreviation i/c is written twice

parts.note: i/c, 'in charge', is written as the letters IC

indicators.note: half takes the first half of the word left

explanation.surface: A second-in-command is left half-heartedly with a feeble hanger-on.
explanation.walkthrough: '2 i/c' looks like 'second in command' but is read literally as IC twice; 'half' takes LE from 'left'.
explanation.definitionFit: An icicle hangs down from eaves and drips as it melts, a witty picture of a drippy hanger-on.

clue.text: Swindler, getting a hundred, left foolish dude finished

parts.note: a con, or con man, is a swindler
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

indicators.note: foolish signals the letters of dude are put in a silly order

explanation.surface: A fraudster took a hundred and walked off from a silly man, his job done.
explanation.definitionFit: Concluded means brought to an end, finished.

clue.text: Left one in the day before, with permission

indicators.note: in places the letter for one within the word for the day before

parts.note: an eve is the day before a festival
A is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: Someone left one thing in on the evening before, having been allowed to.
explanation.definitionFit: Leave means permission, as in asking leave to go.

clue.text: Left inside, Bill is chilly

indicators.note: inside places the abbreviation for left within the word for bill

parts.note: a bird's bill is its beak

explanation.surface: Bill has been left indoors and feels cold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man's name, but it is the bird's beak.
explanation.definitionFit: Bleak weather or landscape is cold and exposed, chilly.

clue.text: The former model has nothing left to celebrate

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
T as in Ford's Model T car
O, the zero shape, stands for nothing

explanation.surface: An ex-model has nothing left to party about.
explanation.definitionFit: To extol is to praise highly, to celebrate in words.

clue.text: Company to support hooded killer?

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment

explanation.surface: A firm backs a masked assassin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hooded killer' suggests an executioner, but it is the snake, which spreads a hood.
explanation.definitionFit: The cobra is a venomous snake that spreads a hood when threatened.

clue.text: Eastern Russian fighter admonished and left the country

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian fighter jet
to rate someone is an old word for to scold or admonish

explanation.surface: An Eastern Bloc pilot was reprimanded and defected abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: To emigrate is to leave one's own country to live in another.

clue.text: Look left, then set out to find loopholes

parts.note: to eye something is to look at it

indicators.note: out signals the letters of set are put out of order

explanation.surface: An inspector looks left and sets off to hunt for gaps in the rules.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Loopholes' suggests legal escape routes, but here it means small holes for threading laces.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyelets are small holes for a cord or lace, literally loopholes.

clue.text: Mosha, shuffling around, left a Jewish farewell

indicators.note: shuffling around means the letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Mosha shuffled about and left with a goodbye in Hebrew.
explanation.definitionFit: Shalom, Hebrew for peace, is used as a greeting and a farewell.
